name: Aino Nieminen
bio:
Aino Nieminen's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines alongside her father, a rally enthusiast. This early exposure ignited a lifelong passion, leading her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering and subsequently dedicate her career to racing. She quickly rose through the ranks, starting as a junior engineer before transitioning into management roles, demonstrating a knack for both technical problem-solving and team leadership.

Known for her calm and collected demeanor under pressure, Aino excels at strategic decision-making during high-stakes situations. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovation is encouraged and every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. Her approach to team principal is defined by meticulous planning, data-driven analysis, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Aino is distinguished by her ability to blend a hands-on technical understanding with a strong focus on human relationships, creating a highly effective and motivated team.

Her dedication to fostering young talent is evident in her commitment to mentoring junior engineers and drivers, ensuring the longevity and success of the sport she loves. With a proven track record of turning underdog teams into competitive contenders, Aino brings a wealth of experience and a strategic mindset to any team she leads.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, styled in a practical, slightly wavy bob
physical.description: Aino has a focused, determined expression and a warm smile that can put anyone at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during races, to jot down observations.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief recap of the previous race's key learnings.
Has a lucky Finnish 'sisu' charm that she keeps in her pocket during every race weekend.
